title: Decide EU residency for booking documents
why: parse-booking reads travellers' booking files; whether they may leave the EU sets which model hosts are allowed, not volume.
how: Read the parse-booking row of the research doc
Choose: EU-hosted only, or any host with a data processing agreement
Tell the next session (E7, S54)

title: Re-rate the trails with the downhill relief fix
why: The fix is in code; about 265 downhill walks move up a band and 37 enter the top band only once the box re-rates.
how: On the box with the trails lab up: python run_pipeline.py --only trails_rate
python run_pipeline.py --only rating_v5_profile
python pipeline/nature_tiers.py --check must print wire matches frozen: True (do not run --recalibrate)
Rerun python pipeline/trails/summaries.py and pytest tests/test_trail_summaries.py
Commit data/trails/summaries.json and data/reports/trails_summaries.json with the new wire

title: Bless the dense and hybrid baseline
why: The Ask index (`public/search/ask/`, about 50 MB) is not in git or in the cloud container.
how: In the main checkout, with `python run_pipeline.py ask_index` already run, `cd continent-app && node scripts/eval/ask-eval.mjs --bless`, then commit `scripts/eval/ask-baseline.json`. Note that the BM25 numbers then come from the shipped index, and CI skips them against a rebuilt run

title: Read the place labels
why: The labels were written by one session from general knowledge.
how: Open `continent-app/scripts/eval/ask-set.json` and check that the places listed for each question are the ones a traveller would expect
Change or add ids, then run `--bless`

title: Keep the quality history on the box
why: `weekly.sh` resets the checkout before each run, which would put the tracked history back and lose the drop baseline.
how: On the box add `CARTA_QUALITY_OUT=logs/status/quality` to the environment the timers use, then once `mkdir -p logs/status/quality && cp data/reports/quality/* logs/status/quality/`

title: Confirm the rules
why: Which fields are must_see (hard, gated on a 2 point drop) and the floors are my call from what each card and page shows.
how: Read `scripts/quality/rules.yaml` (the comment on each line is the share the floor was set from)
Change `level`, `kind` or `min`, or ask a session to

title: Decide where the live panel reads from
why: The panel shows the snapshot the build carried; a run-time read needs a published path for `panel.json`.
how: Choose: R2 `status/` made readable to the admin page, or the box commits the snapshot after each run

title: Choose how trail summaries reach travellers
why: 2,089 checked summaries exist in data/trails/summaries.json but are not on the wire; the app prints `summary` as English prose in every language.
how: Pick one: (1) ship the English text as `summary` (fast, English only), or (2) a next task renders `parts` through t() in en, nl, de, fr, es and it (six languages, more work)
Tell the next session which

title: Rerun the summaries after the trails rebuild
why: The top band, names and grades move when T1092-a and T1094-a run, and the committed file then goes stale.
how: On the box after `trails_rate` and the v5 pass: `python pipeline/trails/summaries.py`, then `python -m pytest tests/test_trail_summaries.py -q`, then commit data/trails/summaries.json and data/reports/trails_summaries.json

title: Deploy the model gateway
why: Plan-day, suggest-city, parse-booking and Ask call models through aiModels only once deployed; suggest-city's guard too.
how: After T1117-a or together with it: `supabase functions deploy plan-day`, `supabase functions deploy suggest-city`, `supabase functions deploy parse-booking`
The Pages build per CLAUDE.md Deploy (preview first)
On the preview run one plan-day day, one town suggestion and one magic import and check each answer's `meta.model` and `meta.guard`, and ask one Ask question

title: Label the plan-day calibration sample
why: The LLM judge needs a kappa against a human before it may gate.
how: Open `continent-app/scripts/eval/plan-day/sample.json` and `rubric.md`, and for each of the 40 plans write "pass" or "fail" in `labels.json` (would a careful local friend hand this plan over as it is?)
Do not open `sample-key.json`
Fill `by` and `at`
Then `cd continent-app && node scripts/eval/run.mjs plan-day --write --dashboard` and commit `labels.json`, `data/reports/evals/` and `docs/reference/evals.md`

title: Install Langfuse on the build box
why: Tracing for E4 and a home for eval runs.
how: Follow `continent-app/scripts/eval/langfuse/README.md`: compare the compose file with the official one, pin digests, fill `.env` from `.env.example`, `docker compose up -d`, open over an SSH tunnel

title: Run the Gemini judge once
why: A second judge to compare with the session judge.
how: On a machine with the pipeline's `GEMINI_API_KEY`: `cd continent-app && CARTA_JUDGE_MODEL=<a model outside plan-day's chain> node scripts/eval/plan-day/judge.mjs --backend gemini`, then `node scripts/eval/run.mjs plan-day --write --dashboard`, commit `judgments/` and the results

title: Deploy the prompt registry
why: The Edge Functions and Ask load their prompts from the bundled registry module only once deployed; the prompts are unchanged.
how: With T1137-a: `supabase functions deploy plan-day`, `supabase functions deploy suggest-city`, `supabase functions deploy parse-booking`, then the Pages build per CLAUDE.md Deploy (preview first)
On the preview run one plan-day day, one town suggestion, one magic import and one Ask question and check each answers as before

title: Reranker live check (E-R2)
why: Workers AI is not reachable from the cloud container.
how: For 20 E1 questions per language, take the top 30 passages of the current path, then run `curl -s -o out.json -w '%{time_total}\n' https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CF_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run/@cf/baai/bge-reranker-base -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"quiet lake village","contexts":[{"text":"<passage 1>"},{"text":"<passage 2>"}],"top_k":10}'` (check the response wrapper on the first call), re-order, score nDCG@10 and recall@5 with `scripts/eval/ask-eval-lib.mjs`

Time p50 and p95 over 200 calls from a deployed Worker with `env.AI.run`, since curl adds your own link. Go only on +0.03 nDCG@10 for free-text questions, no drop on facet questions, added p95 at most 300 ms

title: Rebuild and bless the full index
why: The index is not in git or the container.
how: In the main checkout `python run_pipeline.py ask_index` (it runs `build-ask-bm25.mjs`), confirm the log line for `bm25.json` stays under 400 KB gzip and lists `bm25-beach.json`, `bm25-lake.json`, `bm25-peak.json`, then `cd continent-app && node scripts/eval/ask-eval.mjs --check` (expect sparse, dense and hybrid to run) and `--bless`, and commit `scripts/eval/ask-baseline.json`

title: Review the taxonomy before labelling
why: The labels and the S66 tagger both use this vocabulary, so changes are cheapest now.
how: Read the node tables at the end of `docs/ai/taxonomy-labelling-guide.md` and the `not_a_concept` blocks in `pipeline/taxonomy/mapping.yaml`

Add, merge or rename nodes in `pipeline/taxonomy/carta_taxonomy.yaml` (keep ids stable, bump `version`), then `python -I pipeline/taxonomy/taxonomy.py check` and `python -m pytest tests/test_taxonomy.py -q`

title: Label the 400 items
why: P@5 and F1 on 400 labelled items is the F1 done condition.
how: Open `continent-app/scripts/eval/taxonomy/gold.csv` in a spreadsheet, follow `docs/ai/taxonomy-labelling-guide.md` (every true tag, most specific node, skip the data-rule nodes

About 40 hours at ten items an hour), save as UTF-8 CSV with the same columns, then `cd continent-app && node scripts/eval/run.mjs taxonomy --write --dashboard` and commit `gold.csv`, `data/reports/evals/` and `docs/reference/evals.md`

title: Promote lasting live corrections
why: Live `content_overrides` rows hold fixes that vanish if the table is reset and are not in git.
how: In the admin Content tab, list the rows
For each that should hold for good, draft it in the Overrides tab, merge the pull request, run the pipeline and push the data, then clear the live row

title: Decide how an admin edit should be written
why: ROADMAP I13 asks for an editor that writes, this task drafts only.
how: Choose: a pull request opened from the admin page (needs a GitHub token on an Edge Function), or a staging table the pipeline reads at run time (needs a migration)

title: Verify and complete the trails reference list
why: The 282-trail list was written from search snippets; Wikidata, Wikipedia, the ERA site and national portals were unreachable from the cloud.
how: Where those hosts are reachable, check each start against Wikidata P625 and each relation id (P402)
Complete the Leading Quality Trails (11 of about 24) and Irish trails (16 of about 40)
Rerun python scripts/validation/trails_external.py and commit the reference and results

title: Decide on the shape term for long certified trails
why: The v5 shape term (0 for one-way) and per-km scenery hold long certified trails below the top band (Lechweg 7.5, Peddars Way 7.0, Thames Path 7.7).
how: Read the 30 gap reviews in the report
Choose: keep the rule, or ask a session to lift certified long trails

title: Resolve the 34 new trail seeds on the box
why: The SEEDS_T1181 rows in the famous registry only resolve once the registry and coverage run on the box.
how: On the box run python run_pipeline.py trails_registry
Then python pipeline/trails/coverage_report.py --all
Rerun python scripts/validation/trails_external.py and commit its results

title: Try the MCP server in a real client
why: The tests use the library client; a real client proves the setup text works.
how: In `continent-app` run `npm ci`
In `services/mcp` run `npm ci`
Add the `mcpServers` entry from the README to your client and ask it to price a trip

title: Create the private carta-docs site
why: The docs site only exists as a CI artifact until it is hosted behind a login.
how: In Cloudflare Pages create project `carta-docs`
Put Cloudflare Access (owner email only) in front of it

Download the `carta-docs-site` artifact from a docs-site run (or build with `pip install -r requirements-docs.txt && mkdocs build -d .docs-site`) and run `npx wrangler pages deploy .docs-site --project-name carta-docs`

title: Run the first trails validation on the box
why: The committed result was made on the cloud copy of the wire of 2026-09-13; the box holds the newer lab state, and the D2 gate reads the latest result.
how: After the next trails export run `python -I scripts/validation/runner.py trails --write --check`
If coverage or top band moved on purpose, rerun with `--write-baseline` and say why in a report
Commit `data/reports/validation/`

title: Legal read of the AI page
why: The page and cards state a view of the EU AI Act (Article 50 duty, not high-risk, provider versus deployer); a wrong reading published is a liability.
how: Open `/?legal=ai` on the preview and `docs/ai/model-card-ask.md`, `model-card-plan-day.md`
Send to the lawyer
Change the `aiPage.actP` text and the cards' "EU AI Act reading" sections to what they confirm

title: Native check and translation of the AI page
why: Travellers in five languages see it in English; a machine pass could misstate what a model does.
how: Export the 39 `aiPage.*` keys from en.js
Translate
Have a native speaker read each
Append them to nl, de, fr, es, it

title: Name Ask's AI processing in the privacy policy
why: The policy names Google but not Cloudflare Workers AI, which sees the Ask question and notes.
how: Confirm with Cloudflare whether Workers AI keeps requests in the EU on the current plan (T1135-a)
Add a paragraph to the privacy policy and a row to `docs/legal/ARTICLE30.md`

title: Decide whether the MCP server may read saved trips
why: Saved traveller trips need a per-user auth design (token, scopes, RLS) and a threat model review before any MCP tool can offer them.

title: Decide how the MCP server ships
why: It runs only from a repo checkout today; packaging it or a remote HTTP mode is a choice, and a remote mode needs auth and rate limits first.
